Relates to https://github.com/zscaler/terraform-provider-zia/issues/520

Seems like the [cloudappcontrol.AllAvailableActions](https://github.com/zscaler/terraform-provider-zia/blob/master/zia/validator.go#L708) API call is not returning all the actions that can be used in a specific Cloud App. When using the data source there are missing actions that can be set through the console. The actions are `[ALLOW_FILE_SHARE_UPLOAD ALLOW_FILE_SHARE_VIEW]`. Not sure if it's a terraform provider, Go SDK or API issue.
This is also causing a drift with the Office365 OneClick rules.
This only happens with `GDRIVE` and `ONEDRIVE` Cloud Apps. Terraform plan output:

@(user) it is no "missing". We answered similar question of yours in this issue yesterday https://github.com/zscaler/terraform-provider-zia/issues/520#issuecomment-3887386059

You must use the data source `zia_cloud_app_control_rule_actions` https://registry.terraform.io/providers/zscaler/zia/latest/docs/data-sources/zia_cloud_app_control_rule_actions as already indicated. We no longer do local validation of supported API values, and users are required to either use the data source, or refer to the API documentation for the most updated values API documentation here: https://automate.zscaler.com/docs/api-reference-and-guides/api-reference/zia/cloud-app-control-policy/web-application-rule-resource-get-available-actions
Zscaler DevRel

@(user) that's what I did. It is in the example configuration I added in this bug description. I followed your instructions yet the available actions that can be assigned via the API don't match with what is available in the ZScaler ZIA Console.
Ok We understand the issue now. The problem is related to the API used to retrieve the available actions for each rule type via the data source `zia_cloud_app_control_rule_actions`

blocks.item: The actions: ALLOW_FILE_SHARE_UPLOAD, ALLOW_FILE_SHARE_VIEW are not returned via this endpoint; hence, the diff when running terraform plan/apply.
The only actions currently returned via this endpoint, are the following: (Notice that it does not include ALLOW_FILE_SHARE_UPLOAD, ALLOW_FILE_SHARE_VIEW)
We'll raise an internal BUG with the API team to address that.
Alternatively, you can manually pass the list of actions directly in the `actions` list attribute temporarily to prevent the drift.
We'll keep this case opened until we have an update from our backend team.

You need to upgrade the provider version to the latest where we removed local validation. You are still attempting to run your HCL using the older version that does not contain the workaround/fix. Either way, this is a API bug that has already been filed with our engineering teams. Unless you upgrade to the latest provider version, there is no fix for this.

blocks.text: @(user) Please give it a try on minor version v4.7.7 We removed all local validations to ensure the API itself can provide you the accurate combinations during errors. Be aware that the cloud app control api has very complex rule action combinations. We have added very clear remarks this time around explaining its utilization.

blocks.item: `actions` - (List of String) The actions applied by this rule. You can either use the [zia_cloud_app_control_rule_actions](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/zscaler/zia/latest/docs/data-sources/zia_cloud_app_control_rule_actions) data source to retrieve valid actions, or specify them manually for granular control (e.g., mixing `ALLOW_` and `BLOCK_` for different action categories). See the [Granular Mixed Actions](#granular-mixed-actions) section below for details.
